name: Cussing
overview: Scripture teaches that the words we speak hold great power, with life and death resting in the tongue's influence, and that every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment. The fear of the Lord includes hating evil speech, such as a corrupt or froward mouth, which defiles a person more than what enters the mouth. Believers are called to reject worldly patterns and be transformed by renewing their minds, aligning their speech with God's perfect will rather than indulging in swearing or harmful language.
